section.content: 本发明提供了一种半导体集成电路，具有将串行数据转换成并行数据后存储的功能，即使缩短写入/读出的周期也能够稳定动作。该半导体电路包括：串行/并行转换电路(19)，其把与时钟信号一同输入的串行数据转换为并行数据；存储器(21)，其存储被串行/并行转换电路转换的并行数据；以及写入脉冲发生电路(30)，其发生写入脉冲，该写入脉冲用于通过计数时钟信号，设定存储器内的写入时间。

A semiconductor integrated circuit is provided which comprises a serial/parallel conversion circuit for converting serial data which is input together with a clock signal into parallel data; a memory for storing the parallel data converted by the serial/parallel conversion circuit; and a write pulse producing circuit for producing a pulse to be used to set the period of time for writing data into the memory. The semiconductor integrated circuit converts serial data into parallel data, stores the parallel data, and stably operates even when the cycle of data writing/reading is shortened.

Semiconductor integrated circuitTechnical field

The present invention relates to a kind of serial data be converted to the semiconductor integrated circuit of storing after the parallel data, relate in particular to a kind of built-in RAM (random access memory), drive the semiconductor integrated circuit of the lcd driver etc. of LCD (liquid crystal indicator).

Background technology

Existing pattern is to drive along in the lcd driver in numerous zones that the rectification direction of LCD is cut apart, and writes built-in RAM after by interface the serial data of input being converted to parallel data, reads the data of storing among the RAM then, generates drive signal.This existing lcd driver is seen Fig. 4.

As shown in Figure 4, lcd driver 100 comprises: shift register 109, and it will be converted to parallel data with the serial data (DATA) that clock signal clk is together imported; Latch circuit 110, it latchs parallel data; And RAM111, the data that its storage is latched.

In addition, lcd driver 100 also comprises: counter 101, and its counting clock signal CLK exports pulse by lead-out terminal Q9 after every counting 9 numbers; Trigger FF1, it is synchronous with the pulse signal S1 that exports by counter 101, output pulse signal S2; Delay circuit 102, its delayed pulse signal S2, output pulse signal S3; Trigger FF2, itself and pulse signal S3 are synchronous, output pulse signal S4; Delay circuit 103, its delayed pulse signal S4, output pulse signal S5; Buffer circuit 104; Two NOR circuit 105 and 106; Two transducers 107 and 108; And instruction generating circuit 112, control RAM111 writes/reads.

Fig. 5 represents is the action of the various piece of lcd driver shown in Figure 4.Removed reset mode, after counter-rotating reset signal (RESET signal) becomes high level, as shown in Figure 5, synchronous with clock signal clk, 1 data/commands identification code D/C and data D7～D0 of 8 input to shift register 109 successively, maintain in the trigger in shift register 109 to amount to 9 signal.Between this, 9 pulses that comprise among the counter 101 counting clock signal CLK are by lead-out terminal Q9 output pulse signal S1.

Trigger FF1 with the rising edge of a pulse of pulse signal S1 synchronously after, S2 rises to high level with pulse signal.Delay circuit 102 is only pressed specific time delay pulse signal S2, output pulse signal S3.Pulse signal S3 is inverted by NOR circuit 105.Here, because the pulse signal S3 of counter-rotating is input among the reseting terminal R of trigger FF1, trigger FF1 resets, and pulse signal S2 is back to low level.Its result, the exportable pulse signal S2 of trigger FF1, comprise with delay circuit 102 time of delay same widths pulse.The pulse duration of the pulse signal S3 also pulse duration with pulse signal S2 is identical.

Latch circuit 110 with the pulse trailing edge of pulse signal S3 synchronously after, latch as parallel data, from the 1 bit data/instruction identification code D/C of shift register 109 outputs and data D7～D0 of 8.The production burst signal S3 owing to pass through delay circuit 102 delayed pulse signal S2 is so confirm that these signals are latched by latch circuit 110 by after shift register 109 output signals.

Trigger FF2 with the rising edge of a pulse of pulse signal S3 synchronously after, S4 rises to high level with pulse signal.Delay circuit 103 is only pressed specific time delay pulse signal S4, output pulse signal S5.Pulse signal S5 is by 106 counter-rotatings of NOR circuit.Here, because the pulse signal S5 of counter-rotating is input among the reseting terminal R of trigger FF2, trigger FF2 resets, and pulse signal S4 is back to low level.Its result, the exportable pulse signal S4 of trigger FF2, comprise with delay circuit 103 time of delay same widths pulse.The pulse duration of the pulse signal S5 also pulse duration with pulse signal S4 is identical.

When passing through buffer circuit 104 input pulse signal S5, RAM111 is by latch circuit 110 input data D7～D0.In addition, instruction generating circuit 112 is in by buffer circuit 104 input pulse signal S5, by latch circuit 110 input data/commands identification code D/C and data D7～D0.Data/commands identification code D/C is when presentation directives, and instruction generating circuit 112 for example determines the address of the calendar scheduling that writes/read of RAM111 to specify according to be transmitted next instruction and pulse signal S5 as data D7～D0.In addition, data/commands identification code D/C is when the expression data, and RAM111 writes data D7～D0 according to the write time of instruction generating circuit 112 to the address of appointment.Here, represent of the time of delay decision of the pulse duration of the pulse signal S5 of data write time among the RAM111 by delay circuit 103.

Like this, for the conventional semiconductor integrated circuit, owing to determined the time of delay of the data write time in the RAM by delay circuit, when exchange RAM, sometimes need delay circuit is carried out necessary adjustment, exist the problem that is difficult for shortening the cycle that writes/read.

Summary of the invention

So the present invention has overcome above-mentioned deficiency, its purpose is to provide a kind of semiconductor integrated circuit, has to convert serial data to store after the parallel data function, also can stablize by safety action even shorten the cycle that writes/read.

For overcoming the deficiencies in the prior art, the semiconductor integrated circuit among the present invention comprises: serial-to-parallel converter circuit, and it is converted to parallel data with the serial data that clock signal is together imported; Memory, the parallel data that its storage is changed by serial-to-parallel converter circuit; And write pulse generating circuit, and it writes pulse, and this writes pulse and is used for counting clock signal, sets the write time in the memory.

This semiconductor integrated circuit can also comprise latch circuit, and the parallel data that it latchs by serial-to-parallel converter circuit output offers memory then.In addition, comprise shift register in the serial-to-parallel converter circuit.

In addition, write in the pulse generating circuit and comprise: counter, its counting clock signal; First coincidence detection circuit, the count value of its detection counter overlaps with first particular value; Second coincidence detection circuit, the count value of its detection counter overlaps with second particular value; Sequence circuit, it overlaps the output level that detects in second coincidence detection circuit the coincidence and is made as first level by detecting from first coincidence detection circuit, to from second coincidence detection circuit, detect and overlap the output level that detects in first coincidence detection circuit the coincidence and be made as second level, write pulse thus.

This formation the invention provides a kind of semiconductor integrated circuit, the clock signal that it is together imported by counting and serial data, be used for setting memory write time write pulse, even thereby shorten stable that cycle of writing/reading also can safety action.

Embodiment

Following with reference to accompanying drawing, embodiments of the invention are described.

What Fig. 1 represented is the formation of the semiconductor integrated circuit of first embodiment of the invention.This embodiment describes is that the present invention is applied in situation on the lcd driver, and this lcd driver drives along a plurality of zones of cutting apart on the rectification direction of LCD.

As shown in Figure 1, semiconductor integrated circuit 10 comprises: shift register 19, and it converts parallel data to the serial data (DAYA) that clock signal clk is together imported; Latch circuit 20, it latchs parallel data; And RAM21, the data that its storage is latched.

Semiconductor integrated circuit 10 also comprises: counter 11, the pulse that comprises among its counting clock signal CLK; Trigger FF1, synchronous, the output pulse signal S3 of the pulse signal S9 that itself and counter 11 places export; Delay circuit 12, it makes pulse signal S3 postpone output pulse signal S4; Trigger FF2, itself and pulse signal S4 are synchronous, output pulse signal S5; Delay circuit 13, it makes pulse signal S5 postpone output pulse signal S6; Write pulse generating circuit 30, it is the write time of control RAM, pulsing signal S7; Trigger FF3 and FF4, its maintenance is included in the data/commands identification code D/C in the serial data of importing (DATA); Buffer circuit 14; Two NOR circuit 15 and 16; Two transducers 17 and 18; And instruction generating circuit 22, its control RAM21 writes/reads.

What Fig. 2 represented is the action of the each several part of the semiconductor integrated circuit shown in Fig. 1.Reset mode is disengaged, reverses after reset signal (RESET signal) becomes high level, and is synchronous with clock signal clk as shown in Figure 2, and 8 data D7～D0 is advanced shift register 19 by input successively, remains in the trigger in the shift register 19.During this period, the pulse that comprises among the counter 11 counting clock signal CLK, corresponding output pulse signal S1 with first pulsion phase, corresponding output pulse signal S2 with second pulsion phase is with the corresponding output of the 9th pulsion phase pulse S9.

Synchronous with the rising edge of a pulse of pulse signal S9, trigger FF1 makes pulse signal S3 rise to high level.Delay circuit 12 is only pressed specific time delay pulse signal S3, output pulse signal S4.Pulse signal S4 is by 15 counter-rotatings of NOR circuit.Here, because in the pulse signal S4 of counter-rotating was transfused to the reseting terminal R of trigger FF1 into, trigger FF1 was reset, pulse signal S4 returns low level.Its result, trigger FF1 becomes output pulse signal S3, comprise with delay circuit 12 time of delay same widths pulse.The pulse duration of the pulse signal S4 also pulse duration with pulse signal S3 is identical.

Synchronous with the pulse signal S1 of the lead-out terminal Q1 place of counter 11 output, trigger FF3 keeps data/commands identification code D/C.In addition, synchronous with the pulse signal S2 of the lead-out terminal Q2 place of counter 11 output, trigger FF4 keeps the output signal of trigger FF3, exports as data/commands identification signal A0.

After the pulse trailing edge of latch circuit 20 and pulse signal S4 is synchronous, data D7～D0 of 8 of 1 data/commands identification signal A0 of latched flip flop FF4 place output and the output of shift register 19 places.Delayed circuit 12 delayed pulse signal S3, thereby production burst signal S4, after confirming slave flipflop FF4 and shift register 19 place's output signals, these signals are latched by latch circuit 20.

Synchronous with the rising edge of a pulse of pulse signal S4, trigger FF2 makes pulse signal S5 rise to high level.Delay circuit 13 is only pressed specific time delay pulse signal S5, output pulse signal S6.Pulse signal S6 is by 16 counter-rotatings of NOR circuit.Here, because in the pulse signal S6 of counter-rotating was transfused to the reseting terminal R of trigger FF2 into, trigger FF2 was reset, pulse signal S5 returns low level.Its result, trigger FF2 becomes output pulse signal S5, comprise with delay circuit 13 time of delay same widths pulse.The pulse duration of the pulse signal S6 also pulse duration with pulse signal S5 is identical.Pulse signal S6 is used for executing instruction the instruction of circuit 22 takes place.

In addition, write pulse generating circuit 30 between the rising edge of rising edge to the 5 pulses of the 9th pulse of clock signal clk, output pulse signal S7 is used to write the data that become high level.

RAM21 is by writing pulse generating circuit 30 input pulse signal (writing pulse) S7, by latch circuit 20 input data D7～D0.In addition, instruction generating circuit 22 is by buffer circuit 14 input pulse signal S6, by latch circuit 20 input data/commands identification signal A0 and data D7～D0.Data/commands identification signal A0 is when presentation directives, and instruction generating circuit 22 is according to being transmitted next instruction as data D7～D0, and assigned address for example determines the time that writes/read of RAM21 etc.In addition, data/commands identification signal A0 is when the expression data, and RAM21 writes data D7～D0 to the address of appointment.

Here, the pulse duration of the pulse signal S7 of data write time among the expression RAM21, by writing pulse generating circuit 30, the pulse that is included in the clock signal clk by counting decides.Because it is wide that the pulse duration of pulse signal S7 is got,, also can guarantee writing of data even the cycle that writes/read is short and high speed motion.

Below be elaborated with regard to the pulse generating circuit that writes shown in Figure 1.What Fig. 3 represented is the formation that writes pulse generating circuit.As shown in Figure 3, the formation that writes pulse generating circuit 30 comprises: counter 31, and its counting is included in the pulse in the clock signal clk; Coincidence detection circuit 32, it is used to detect from 4 count value of counter 31 outputs and overlapping of predefined first value (5=" 0101 "); Transducer 34, its output signal to coincidence detection circuit 32 is reversed; Coincidence detection circuit 33, it is used to detect from 4 count value of counter 31 outputs and overlapping of predefined second value (9=" 1001 "); Trigger FF5, it exports the pulse that writes of negative logic according to the output signal of coincidence detection circuit 32 and 33; And transducer 35, counter-rotating is by the pulse that writes of the negative logic of trigger FF5 output.

Reset mode is disengaged, reverses after reset signal becomes high level, and the output signal of trigger FF5 becomes low level.When counter 31 had been counted the 5th pulse that is included in the clock signal clk, the count value that coincidence detection circuit 32 detects counter 31 was with after first value (5) overlaps, the output pulse.Like this, the output signal of trigger FF5 is set at high level, from transducer 35 output low level signals.

Then, when counter 31 has been counted the 9th pulse that comprises in the clock signal clk, after the overlapping of the count value that coincidence detection circuit 33 detects counter 31 and second value (9), the output pulse.The output signal of trigger FF5 with the impulsive synchronization of coincidence detection circuit 33 output after become low level, from transducer 35 output high level signals.

According to above situation, write pulse generating circuit 30 between count value is in 9 and 1～4 the time, the output high level signal, in the time of between count value is in 5～8, the output low level signal.In addition, in the present invention, though when count value is 5 and 9, the output level that writes pulse generating circuit 30 changes, and for other count value, output level also can change.

In sum, the invention provides a kind of semiconductor integrated circuit, by the clock signal that counting is together imported with serial data, be used for setting memory write time write pulse, even thereby shorten stablizing that cycle of writing/reading also can safety action.
